answer_1.quote: We define four primary QA task types: (1) Video Summarization: Generating concise summaries of the video content. (2) General Video QA: Answering questions about objects, attributes, actions, trajectories, and reasoning based on video details. (3) Creative Writing: Producing imaginative content inspired by the video. (4) Temporal Understanding: Analyzing the sequence of events within the video.
answer_1.outputs: Video summaries, creative texts, and question-answering responses

answer_2.quote: We evaluate our model on VideoMME, MLVU, LongVideoBench, and TempCompass.
